title: Trôi về giấc mơ
about: Round x6, for sleep (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi nhiều bài nữa, phù hợp cho các người nghe có thể nghe để ngủ"): drifting off: the old music box plays a gentle lullaby, slower and softer each time, the low strings rocking in three, the pad under them. B minor at 54 bpm in three, about four and a half minutes. Nothing sudden: no thunder, heartbeat or struck bells. An original piece.
